title: Beyond Deduplication: Sharp Retrieval Limits for Attention with Correlated Distractors
abstract: arXiv:2610.34682v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Redundant context affects attention through two distinct mechanisms: repeated items add normalization mass, while score variation within correlated groups can produce extreme individual scores. We separate these effects in a planted retrieval model with exponentially many Gaussian distractors arranged in known, exponentially large clusters. The model is a two-level generalized random energy model, whose classical free energy yields exact retrieval thresholds. Gaussian interpolation further shows that increasing positive correlation at fixed token count lowers the distractor free energy, unlike adding duplicates. Our main result identifies a sharp limitation of subtracting log cluster size from pre-softmax scores: this correction removes multiplicity but retains within-cluster extremes. translated_title: 超越去重：具有相关干扰项的注意力检索的尖锐极限
translated_abstract: 冗余上下文通过两种不同的机制影响注意力：重复项会增加归一化质量，而相关组内的分数波动可能产生极端的个体分数。我们在一个植入式检索模型中分离这些效应，该模型包含指数级数量的高斯干扰项，它们排列在已知的、指数级大小的簇中。该模型是一个两级广义随机能量模型，其经典自由能给出了精确的检索阈值。高斯插值进一步表明，在固定token数量的情况下，增加正相关性会降低干扰项的自由能，这与添加重复项的效果不同。我们的主要结果指出了从softmax前分数中减去对数簇大小这一校正方法的尖锐局限：该校正消除了多重性影响，但保留了簇内的极值。即使在观察到所有分数之后才选择的温度，也无法将所需信号降低到 $\sqrt{2\alpha_1}$ 以下，其中 $\alpha_1$ 是指数速率（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明了对相关干扰项从softmax前分数中减去对数簇大小的校正方法虽能消除重复性的影响，却无法消除簇内极端分数的影响，且即使采用最优温度调节，所需检索信号也无法低于 $\sqrt{2\alpha_1}$，从而揭示了注意力机制在面对相关干扰项时的尖锐检索极限。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that subtracting the log cluster size from pre-softmax scores removes multiplicity effects of correlated distractors but retains within-cluster extremes, and even optimally chosen temperature cannot lower the required retrieval signal below $\sqrt{2\alpha_1}$, revealing a sharp retrieval limit for attention with correlated distractors.
